title: Functional health literacy and medication adherence in atrial fibrillation patients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) treatment requires strict, long-term adherence to oral anticoagulants (OACs) to decrease associated morbidity risks. Despite its importance, adherence varies widely; nonadherence contributes to life-threatening adverse outcomes and elevated costs. Health literacy (HL)-the ability to acquire, comprehend, evaluate, and apply health information-is an important, yet underestimated factor. Given conflicting evidence on the HL-adherence association in chronic diseases, this study investigated this relationship and influencing demographic/contextual factors in AF patients across Iran.

METHODS: This descriptive-analytical cross-sectional, multicenter study was conducted in 2025 across Tehran, Kurdistan, and Kermanshah provinces on 407 adult AF patients receiving OAC therapy. Functional HL was assessed using the HELIA questionnaire; medication adherence was evaluated via MMAS-8. Analysis involved Pearson correlation, independent-samples t-tests, and multiple linear regression.

RESULTS: Mean total HL score was 108.65 ± 30.96 (moderate); mean MMAS-8 was 2.61 ± 1.54 (relatively high adherence). Total HL demonstrated a significant negative correlation with MMAS-8 scores (r = -0.099, p < 0.05), indicating higher HL associates with improved adherence, driven primarily by the "Information" subscale (r = -0.172, p < 0.01). While males had significantly higher HL scores (p < 0.001), females showed better adherence (p = 0.045). Notably, older age was paradoxically linked to worse adherence in Kurdistan (r = 0.327, p < 0.01). In multiple linear regression adjusting for age, gender, and study site (R2 = 0.214, p < 0.001), total HL emerged as a strong independent predictor of better adherence (β = -0.500, p < 0.001), alongside older age, female gender, and residing in Kurdistan (all p < 0.001).

CONCLUSIONS: Health literacy is a statistically significant, independent and modifiable predictor of medication adherence in Iranian AF populations. Efficacy is specific to functional information application, highlighting the need for interventions focused on practical skills. The complex age-gender interaction demonstrates how regional socioeconomic and cultural contexts affect the HL-adherence relationship.

AI.tldr: 在伊朗407例接受口服抗凝治疗的房颤患者中，功能性健康素养是服药依从性的独立预测因子，且关联主要由信息应用维度驱动。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者需长期严格服用口服抗凝药以降低血栓栓塞风险，但依从性差异大且不依从可导致严重不良结局。健康素养作为可获取、理解、评价和应用健康信息的能力，其与依从性的关联在慢性病中证据矛盾，在房颤人群中尚不明确。
AI.method: 2025年在伊朗德黑兰、库尔德斯坦和克尔曼沙赫三省开展多中心描述性分析横断面研究，纳入407例接受口服抗凝治疗的成年房颤患者。使用HELIA问卷评估功能性健康素养，MMAS-8评估服药依从性。统计分析采用Pearson相关、独立样本t检验和多线性回归。
AI.result: 平均健康素养总分108.65±30.96（中等），平均MMAS-8评分2.61±1.54（依从性相对较高）。健康素养总分与MMAS-8呈显著负相关（r=-0.099，p<0.05），主要由“信息”子量表驱动（r=-0.172，p<0.01）。男性健康素养更高（p<0.001），女性依从性更好（p=0.045）。在库尔德斯坦，年龄较大反而与更差依从性相关（r=0.327，p<0.01）。多线性回归调整年龄、性别和研究地点后（R²=0.214，p<0.001），健康素养总分是更好依从性的强独立预测因子（β=-0.500，p<0.001），同时年龄较大、女性、居住在库尔德斯坦也与更好依从性独立相关（均p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 健康素养是伊朗房颤患者服药依从性的独立且可干预的预测因子，其效应特异于功能性信息应用能力，提示干预应侧重实践技能。年龄与性别的复杂交互作用反映地区社会经济文化背景对健康素养-依从性关系的影响。本研究为横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，且结果外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）的治疗需要严格、长期坚持口服抗凝药（OACs）以降低相关发病风险。尽管其重要性，依从性差异很大；不依从会导致危及生命的不良结局和费用增加。健康素养（HL）——获取、理解、评估和应用健康信息的能力——是一个重要但被低估的因素。鉴于慢性病中HL与依从性关联的证据存在矛盾，本研究在伊朗AF患者中调查了这一关系及影响的人口学/背景因素。

方法：这项描述性-分析性横断面、多中心研究于2025年在德黑兰、库尔德斯坦和克尔曼沙赫省对407名接受OAC治疗的成年AF患者进行。功能性HL使用HELIA问卷评估；药物依从性通过MMAS-8评估。分析包括Pearson相关、独立样本t检验和多元线性回归。

结果：平均总HL得分为108.65 ± 30.96（中等）；平均MMAS-8为2.61 ± 1.54（依从性相对较高）。总HL与MMAS-8得分呈显著负相关（r = -0.099，p < 0.05），表明较高的HL与更好的依从性相关，主要由“信息”子量表驱动（r = -0.172，p < 0.01）。男性HL得分显著更高（p < 0.001），而女性表现出更好的依从性（p = 0.045）。值得注意的是，在库尔德斯坦，年龄较大与更差的依从性 paradoxically 相关（r = 0.327，p < 0.01）。在调整年龄、性别和研究地点的多元线性回归中（R2 = 0.214，p < 0.001），总HL成为更好依从性的强独立预测因子（β = -0.500，p < 0.001），同时年龄较大、女性性别和居住在库尔德斯坦（均p < 0.001）也是预测因子。

结论：健康素养是伊朗AF人群中药物依从性的统计学显著、独立且可修改的预测因子。效力特定于功能性信息应用，突出需要关注实用技能的干预措施。复杂的年龄-性别交互作用表明区域社会经济和文化背景如何影响HL-依从性关系。

title: Left Atrial Appendage Aneurysm Presenting With Atrial Fibrillation in a Young Woman: A Case Report.
summary: Left atrial appendage aneurysm (LAAA) is a rare cardiac anomaly. We report a 25-year-old woman with LAAA presenting with atrial fibrillation and dyspnea. Multimodality imaging enabled diagnosis, and successful surgical resection was performed. Histopathology confirmed a benign aneurysm. At 6-month follow-up, no recurrence or thromboembolic events were observed.

AI.tldr: 25岁女性左心耳瘤合并房颤及呼吸困难，多模态影像确诊后行手术切除，病理为良性，6个月随访无复发及血栓栓塞事件。
AI.motivation: 左心耳瘤（LAAA）是极罕见的心脏结构异常，可与房颤、血栓栓塞及心衰相关；既往多为个案报道，年轻患者中以房颤为首发表现者更少，临床易漏诊，需明确影像诊断路径与手术切除的价值。
AI.method: 个案报告。对象为1例25岁女性，因心房颤动与呼吸困难就诊，经多模态影像学检查诊断为左心耳瘤；行外科手术切除，标本送病理检查；随访6个月，观察房颤复发与血栓栓塞事件。摘要未报告具体影像方法、手术方式及终点统计方法。
AI.result: 多模态影像明确诊断并完成手术切除，组织病理证实为良性动脉瘤。术后6个月随访期内未见复发，亦未发生血栓栓塞事件。摘要未报告房颤复发率、瘤体大小及抗凝方案等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示对年轻、无结构性心脏病背景的房颤患者应考虑罕见结构异常如LAAA，多模态影像有助于确诊，外科切除在短期随访中安全有效。但为单个病例、随访仅6个月，长期心律失常与栓塞风险及是否需要持续抗凝尚不明确，结论不能外推。

summary_zh: 左心耳瘤（LAAA）是一种罕见的心脏异常。我们报告一例25岁女性LAAA患者，表现为心房颤动和呼吸困难。多模态影像学检查实现了诊断，并成功实施了手术切除。组织病理学证实为良性动脉瘤。随访6个月，未观察到复发或血栓栓塞事件。

title: Atrial Fibrillation During Zanubrutinib Treatment in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia With a Historical Ibrutinib Control.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Atrial fibrillation (AF) complicates Bruton tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy in chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

METHODS: We retrospectively evaluated 679 zanubrutinib-treated patients across 52 Italian centers, with 354 historical ibrutinib-treated controls. Shanafelt AF scores were assessed.

RESULTS: Nine zanubrutinib-treated patients developed AF (1.33%) during median treatment of 15.5 months, versus 42 historical controls (11.9%) over median observation of 25 months. Five zanubrutinib events occurred among patients scoring ≥ 5. No affected patients experienced embolic or bleeding complications.

CONCLUSION: AF was uncommon during zanubrutinib treatment, even in the higher-risk subgroup. Historical comparisons remain limited, and exploratory score findings require confirmation with longer follow-up.

TRIAL REGISTRATION: The authors have confirmed clinical trial registration is not needed for this submission.

AI.result: 泽布替尼组中位治疗15.5个月期间9例发生房颤（1.33%），历史伊布替尼对照组中位观察25个月期间42例发生房颤（11.9%）；泽布替尼组5例房颤事件发生于Shanafelt评分≥5分的患者；发生房颤的患者均未出现栓塞或出血并发症。摘要未报告置信区间与P值。

方法：我们回顾性评估了意大利52个中心接受泽布替尼治疗的679例患者，并以354例既往接受伊布替尼治疗的患者作为历史对照。评估了Shanafelt AF评分。

title: Pulmonary Vein Reconnection Burden and Extra-Pulmonary Vein Ablation During Second Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation in the Pre-Pulsed-Field Ablation Era: A Multicenter Registry.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Contemporary procedural characteristics of second catheter ablation (CA) for atrial fibrillation (AF) remain incompletely characterized.

OBJECTIVE: To investigate procedural characteristics and clinical implications of pulmonary vein (PV) reconnection during second CA for AF.

METHODS: We analyzed 854 patients who underwent second CA for AF between April 2021 and March 2024 at nine institutions before the clinical adoption of pulsed-field ablation. Patients were stratified according to the number of reconnected PVs identified during the procedures: none (0), single (1), and multiple (≥ 2). The primary endpoint was freedom from atrial arrhythmia recurrence, assessed using multivariable Cox proportional hazards models.

RESULTS: During second CA, PV reconnections (21% per vein) were identified and re-isolated in all affected PVs. Patients with no PV reconnection accounted for 55.5% (n = 474) of the cohort and underwent extra-PV ablation more frequently than those with single (n = 146) or multiple (n = 234) reconnected PVs. During a median follow-up of 706 days, multiple reconnected PVs with subsequent re-isolation were associated with a lower risk of atrial arrhythmia recurrence than no PV reconnection. This association remained significant after multivariable adjustment (hazard ratio 0.69, 95% confidence interval 0.50-0.95; p = 0.023) and was more pronounced in patients without symptomatic heart failure (p for interaction = 0.009). Enlarged left atrial diameter, non-paroxysmal AF, and symptomatic heart failure were also independently associated with recurrence, whereas additional extra-PV ablation was not.

CONCLUSION: Re-isolation of multiple reconnected PVs was independently associated with a lower risk of atrial arrhythmia recurrence after second CA for AF, particularly in patients without symptomatic heart failure.

AI.tldr: 在二次房颤消融中，多支肺静脉重连并再隔离与较低的房性心律失常复发风险独立相关（HR 0.69），尤其在无有症状心衰患者中更明显。
AI.motivation: 二次房颤导管消融的手术特征尚不明确，肺静脉重连对临床结局的影响有待探讨，尤其在脉冲场消融广泛应用前的时代。
AI.method: 多中心注册研究，纳入2021年4月至2024年3月在9家机构接受二次房颤消融的854例患者（脉冲场消融临床采用前）。按术中重连肺静脉数量分层：无（0）、单支（1）、多支（≥2）。主要终点为无房性心律失常复发，采用多变量Cox比例风险模型评估。
AI.result: 术中肺静脉重连率为每支21%，所有受累肺静脉均再隔离。无重连者占55.5%（474例），接受额外肺静脉外消融更频繁。中位随访706天，多支重连并再隔离者较无重连者复发风险更低，多变量调整后仍显著（HR 0.69，95%CI 0.50-0.95；P=0.023），在无有症状心衰患者中更明显（交互P=0.009）。左房内径增大、非阵发性房颤和有症状心衰亦独立与复发相关，而额外肺静脉外消融无显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 二次房颤消融中，多支重连肺静脉的再隔离与较低的房性心律失常复发风险独立相关，尤其见于无有症状心衰患者。这提示术中应重视肺静脉重连的识别与再隔离，但研究为观察性注册，存在选择偏倚可能，且结果需在脉冲场消融时代进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：针对心房颤动（AF）的第二次导管消融（CA）的当代手术特征仍未被充分描述。

目的：探讨第二次CA治疗AF过程中肺静脉（PV）重连的手术特征及临床意义。

方法：我们分析了2021年4月至2024年3月期间在九家机构接受第二次CA治疗AF的854例患者，这些患者均在脉冲场消融临床采用之前。根据手术中发现的重新连接的PV数量对患者进行分层：无（0）、单支（1）和多支（≥2）。主要终点是无房性心律失常复发，使用多变量Cox比例风险模型进行评估。

结果：在第二次CA期间，发现PV重连（每静脉21%）并对所有受累PV重新隔离。无PV重连的患者占队列的55.5%（n=474），并且比单支（n=146）或多支（n=234）重连PV的患者更频繁地接受额外PV消融。在中位随访706天期间，多支重连PV并随后重新隔离与无PV重连相比，与房性心律失常复发风险较低相关。这种关联在多变量调整后仍然显著（风险比0.69，95%置信区间0.50-0.95；p=0.023），并且在无症状性心力衰竭患者中更为明显（交互作用p=0.009）。左心房直径增大、非阵发性AF和症状性心力衰竭也与复发独立相关，而额外的额外PV消融则不是。

结论：多支重连PV的重新隔离与第二次CA治疗AF后房性心律失常复发风险较低独立相关，特别是在无症状性心力衰竭患者中。

title: COMPARATIVE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF ANTICOAGULATION STRATEGIES FOR ELECTRICAL CARDIOVERSION OF ATRIAL FIBRILLATION: A COMPREHENSIVE SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS OF RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIALS AND PRIMARY STUDIES
summary: Introduction: Electrical cardioversion (ECV) is the most effective method for restoring sinus rhythm in atrial fibrillation (AF), but it transiently amplifies the risk of thromboembolism through atrial stunning and a post-conversion prothrombotic state. Several anticoagulation strategies coexist in contemporary practice: dose-adjusted vitamin K antagonists (VKA) with or without heparin bridging, non-vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulants (NOAC), imaging-guided early versus conventional delayed cardioversion, and, in acute-onset AF, cardioversion without periprocedural anticoagulation. Their comparative efficacy and safety have not been integrated within a single quantitative framework that combines randomized and real-world evidence. We therefore aimed to compare these strategies with respect to thromboembolism, bleeding, mortality, and pre-cardioversion left atrial thrombus. Methods: The study strictly adhered to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines. PubMed, Europe PMC, Google Scholar, Semantic Scholar, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched for reports published between January 2011 and October 2026. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs), RCT-derived cardioversion analyses, comparative cohort studies, and case series of adults undergoing ECV for AF or atrial flutter were eligible. Risk of bias was assessed with RoB 2, ROBINS-I, and the JBI checklist for case series. Risk ratios (RR) were pooled with DerSimonian–Laird random-effects models, complemented by Mantel–Haenszel fixed-effect, Peto, and Hartung–Knapp–Sidik–Jonkman (HKSJ) analyses with prediction intervals; adjusted estimates were pooled by generic inverse variance and single-arm incidences by the Freeman–Tukey transformation. Certainty of evidence was graded with GRADE. Results: Thirty-five studies (42 reports) were included: 8 RCTs or RCT-derived analyses, 20 comparative cohorts, and 7 case series, encompassing 93,271 patients or cardioversion procedures. Compared with VKA, NOAC-based anticoagulation yielded a similar risk of stroke or systemic embolism (RR 0.90; 95% CI 0.65–1.26; 18 studies; I² = 0%), with a numerically lower estimate in randomized evidence (RR 0.60; 95% CI 0.27–1.35). Major bleeding was reduced (RR 0.66; 95% CI 0.45–0.96; 17 studies; absolute difference -1.6 per 1,000 cardioversions), a benefit driven by observational cohorts and attenuated in randomized trials (RR 0.91; 95% CI 0.49–1.70). In dedicated cardioversion RCTs, the trial-defined efficacy composite was lower with NOAC (RR 0.43; 95% CI 0.21–0.87), and ischaemic stroke was reduced (RR 0.10; 95% CI 0.01–0.77; 2 RCTs). All-cause mortality did not differ (RR 0.74; 95% CI 0.32–1.68). Treatment effects were consistent across early/transoesophageal echocardiography (TEE)-guided and delayed strategies (P for interaction = 0.80), individual NOACs (P = 0.38), and prior anticoagulant exposure (P = 0.55). Imaging-guided/early cardioversion was not associated with different thromboembolic risk compared with conventional delayed cardioversion (RR 0.88; 95% CI 0.41–1.90). Periprocedural oral anticoagulation, compared with none, reduced thromboembolism by 63% (RR 0.37; 95% CI 0.28–0.49; 7 studies; I² = 0%). Pooled post-cardioversion thromboembolic incidence was 0.17% with NOAC, 0.32% with VKA, and 0.45% without anticoagulation. Certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low. Discussion: NOAC-based strategies provide thromboembolic protection at least equivalent to well-managed VKA during ECV, with a favourable but design-dependent bleeding signal and practical advantages that permit earlier cardioversion. The protective effect of periprocedural anticoagulation is large and consistent, including in acute-onset AF, whereas the choice between imaging-guided early and conventional delayed timing does not appear to modify thromboembolic risk when therapeutic anticoagulation is ensured. Conclusion: Uninterrupted therapeutic anticoagulation, preferably with a NOAC, should accompany every electrical cardioversion of AF irrespective of AF duration in patients with thromboembolic risk factors, either for at least 3 weeks before cardioversion or with imaging exclusion of left atrial thrombus, and for at least 4 weeks afterwards. Adequately powered randomized trials of strategy timing, reduced-dose regimens, and acute-onset AF are still required.

AI.tldr: 在房颤电复律中，NOAC与VKA相比卒中/体循环栓塞风险相似，但大出血更少；围术期抗凝较无抗凝显著降低血栓栓塞风险。
AI.motivation: 电复律是恢复房颤窦性心律的有效方法，但可因心房顿抑和促血栓状态增加血栓栓塞风险。现有多种抗凝策略并存，其比较疗效和安全性尚未在整合随机与真实世界证据的定量框架中评估。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，遵循PRISMA 2020，检索2011年1月至2026年10月文献，纳入RCT、RCT衍生分析、比较队列和病例系列，共35项研究（42篇报告），93,271例患者或复律操作。比较VKA（伴或不伴肝素桥接）、NOAC、影像引导早期与常规延迟复律、急性房颤无围术期抗凝等策略。终点包括血栓栓塞、出血、死亡和复律前左房血栓。采用随机效应模型合并风险比（RR），辅以固定效应、Peto、HKSJ分析及预测区间，GRADE分级评估证据质量。
AI.result: 与VKA相比，NOAC卒中/体循环栓塞风险相似（RR 0.90；95% CI 0.65–1.26；18项研究；I²=0%），大出血减少（RR 0.66；95% CI 0.45–0.96；17项研究；绝对差异-1.6/1000次复律），但随机证据中出血获益减弱（RR 0.91；95% CI 0.49–1.70）。专用复律RCT中NOAC复合疗效终点更低（RR 0.43；95% CI 0.21–0.87），缺血性卒中减少（RR 0.10；95% CI 0.01–0.77；2项RCT）。全因死亡无差异（RR 0.74；95% CI 0.32–1.68）。影像引导/早期复律与延迟复律血栓栓塞风险无差异（RR 0.88；95% CI 0.41–1.90）。围术期口服抗凝较无抗凝降低血栓栓塞63%（RR 0.37；95% CI 0.28–0.49；7项研究；I²=0%）。复律后血栓栓塞发生率：NOAC 0.17%、VKA 0.32%、无抗凝0.45%。证据质量低至极低。
AI.conclusion: 电复律期间NOAC至少提供与良好管理VKA等效的血栓栓塞保护，出血信号有利但受研究设计影响，且便于早期复律。围术期抗凝保护作用大且一致，包括急性房颤；在确保治疗性抗凝时，影像引导早期与常规延迟复律不改变血栓栓塞风险。建议所有有血栓栓塞风险因素的房颤患者电复律时全程治疗性抗凝（优选NOAC），复律前至少3周或影像排除左房血栓，复律后至少4周。仍需足够样本量的RCT探讨策略时机、减量方案和急性房颤。

summary_zh: 引言：电复律（ECV）是恢复心房颤动（AF）患者窦性心律最有效的方法，但通过心房顿抑和复律后促血栓状态，会短暂增加血栓栓塞风险。当代实践中并存多种抗凝策略：剂量调整的维生素K拮抗剂（VKA）联合或不联合肝素桥接、非维生素K拮抗剂口服抗凝药（NOAC）、影像引导的早期与常规延迟复律，以及在急性发作AF中不进行围术期抗凝的复律。这些策略的比较疗效和安全性尚未在一个结合随机和真实世界证据的单一量化框架内进行整合。因此，我们旨在比较这些策略在血栓栓塞、出血、死亡率和复律前左心房血栓方面的差异。方法：本研究严格遵循系统评价和Meta分析首选报告项目（PRISMA）2020指南。检索了PubMed、Europe PMC、Google Scholar、Semantic Scholar和ClinicalTrials.gov，查找2011年1月至2026年10月间发表的报告。纳入标准为随机对照试验（RCT）、源自RCT的复律分析、比较性队列研究以及接受ECV治疗AF或心房扑动的成人病例系列。使用RoB 2、ROBINS-I和JBI病例系列清单评估偏倚风险。使用DerSimonian–Laird随机效应模型合并风险比（RR），辅以Mantel–Haenszel固定效应、Peto和Hartung–Knapp–Sidik–Jonkman（HKSJ）分析及预测区间；调整估计值通过通用逆方差法合并，单臂发生率通过Freeman–Tukey转换合并。证据确定性采用GRADE分级。结果：共纳入35项研究（42份报告）：8项RCT或源自RCT的分析、20项比较性队列和7项病例系列，涵盖93,271名患者或复律操作。与VKA相比，基于NOAC的抗凝治疗卒中或系统性栓塞风险相似（RR 0.90；95% CI 0.65–1.26；18项研究；I² = 0%），随机证据中估计值数值上更低（RR 0.60；95% CI 0.27–1.35）。大出血减少（RR 0.66；95% CI 0.45–0.96；17项研究；绝对差异每1,000次复律-1.6），这一获益由观察性队列驱动，在随机试验中减弱（RR 0.91；95% CI 0.49–1.70）。在专门的复律RCT中，NOAC的试验定义疗效复合终点更低（RR 0.43；95% CI 0.21–0.87），缺血性卒中减少（RR 0.10；95% CI 0.01–0.77；2项RCT）。全因死亡率无差异（RR 0.74；95% CI 0.32–1.68）。治疗效果在早期/经食管超声心动图（TEE）引导与延迟策略（交互作用P = 0.80）、个体NOAC（P = 0.38）和既往抗凝暴露（P = 0.55）之间一致。与常规延迟复律相比，影像引导/早期复律与血栓栓塞风险不同无关（RR 0.88；95% CI 0.41–1.90）。与无围术期口服抗凝相比，围术期口服抗凝使血栓栓塞减少63%（RR 0.37；95% CI 0.28–0.49；7项研究；I² = 0%）。复律后血栓栓塞的合并发生率在NOAC中为0.17%，VKA中为0.32%，无抗凝中为0.45%。证据确定性从低到极低不等。讨论：基于NOAC的策略在ECV期间提供至少等同于管理良好的VKA的血栓栓塞保护，具有有利但依赖设计的出血信号以及允许更早复律的实际优势。围术期抗凝的保护作用大且一致，包括在急性发作AF中，而当确保治疗性抗凝时，影像引导早期与常规延迟时机的选择似乎不改变血栓栓塞风险。结论：对于有血栓栓塞风险因素的患者，无论AF持续时间如何，每次AF电复律都应伴随不间断的治疗性抗凝，最好使用NOAC，要么在复律前至少3周，要么通过影像排除左心房血栓，并在复律后至少4周。仍需要关于策略时机、减剂量方案和急性发作AF的充分把握度的随机试验。

title: Hybrid surgical-electrophysiological epicardial cryoablation for ventricular tachycardia storm from a deep intramural substrate in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Ventricular tachycardia (VT) associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) may arise from deep intramural substrates and remains challenging to treat when conventional endocardial or percutaneous epicardial approaches are ineffective or infeasible.

CASE SUMMARY: A 63-year-old man with HCM presented with drug-resistant VT storm. Endocardial mapping showed marked narrowing of the left ventricular (LV) cavity at the midventricular level, without abnormal potentials. Pace mapping demonstrated the closest match at the distal anterolateral coronary venous branch, suggesting a deep intramural origin. A subxiphoid epicardial approach was precluded by prior oesophageal reconstruction; therefore, minimally invasive cardiac surgery via left thoracotomy enabled epicardial cryoablation using the cryoICE system. Epicardial mapping during VT revealed a low-voltage area with fractionated electrograms at the apicolateral LV. Activation time did not span the full VT cycle length, suggesting an epicardial exit with a deep intramural isthmus. VT terminated during the first cryoapplication, followed by two additional applications (total 15 min). No VT recurrence was observed during 1 year of follow-up after discontinuation of amiodarone. Postprocedural cardiac magnetic resonance demonstrated transmural enhancement at the cryoablation target site despite a myocardial thickness of approximately 15 mm, suggesting successful deep lesion formation.

DISCUSSION: This case demonstrated that hybrid surgical-electrophysiological cryoablation can provide effective treatment for VT arising from deep intramural substrates when conventional endocardial and percutaneous epicardial approaches are ineffective or infeasible. Surgical cryoablation was associated with transmural enhancement despite marked myocardial hypertrophy and resulted in durable arrhythmia suppression.

AI.tldr: 一例HCM合并药物难治性VT电风暴患者，因深部壁内基质且经皮心外膜途径不可行，采用杂交外科-电生理心外膜冷冻消融成功终止VT，随访1年无复发。
AI.motivation: HCM相关VT可起源于深部壁内基质，常规心内膜或经皮心外膜途径无效或不可行时治疗极具挑战，需探索替代消融策略。
AI.method: 病例报告。63岁男性HCM患者，药物难治性VT电风暴。心内膜标测示左室中段腔明显狭窄、无异常电位；起搏标测提示深部壁内起源。因既往食管重建术禁经剑突下心外膜途径，遂经左胸小切口微创外科途径，使用cryoICE系统行心外膜冷冻消融。VT时心外膜标测示左室心尖侧壁低电压区伴碎裂电位，激动时间未覆盖整个VT周长，提示心外膜出口伴深部壁内峡部。VT于首次冷冻消融时终止，共3次、总15分钟。主要观察VT复发及影像学消融深度。
AI.result: 首次冷冻消融即终止VT，追加2次共15分钟。停用胺碘酮后随访1年无VT复发。术后心脏磁共振示消融靶点处透壁强化，尽管心肌厚度约15 mm，提示深部病灶形成成功。
AI.conclusion: 杂交外科-电生理冷冻消融可为常规心内膜和经皮心外膜途径无效或不可行的深部壁内VT提供有效治疗，在明显心肌肥厚下实现透壁强化并持久抑制心律失常。但为单例报告，需更多研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：与肥厚型心肌病（HCM）相关的室性心动过速（VT）可能起源于深部心肌内基质，当常规心内膜或经皮心外膜途径无效或不可行时，治疗仍具有挑战性。

病例摘要：一名63岁男性HCM患者表现为药物难治性VT风暴。心内膜标测显示左心室（LV）腔在中部心室水平明显狭窄，未见异常电位。起搏标测显示在冠状静脉远端前侧支匹配最佳，提示深部心肌内起源。由于既往食管重建术，剑突下心外膜途径受阻；因此，通过左胸廓切开术的微创心脏手术使得使用cryoICE系统进行心外膜冷冻消融成为可能。VT期间的心外膜标测显示左心室心尖侧部低电压区伴碎裂电图。激动时间未覆盖整个VT周期长度，提示心外膜出口伴深部心肌内峡部。首次冷冻消融应用期间VT终止，随后又进行了两次应用（总共15分钟）。停用胺碘酮后随访1年，未观察到VT复发。术后心脏磁共振显示冷冻消融靶点部位透壁强化，尽管心肌厚度约15 mm，提示成功形成深部损伤。

讨论：本病例表明，当常规心内膜和经皮心外膜途径无效或不可行时，杂交手术-电生理冷冻消融可为起源于深部心肌内基质的VT提供有效治疗。尽管存在明显心肌肥厚，手术冷冻消融与透壁强化相关，并导致持久的心律失常抑制。

title: Evaluation of a novel transseptal puncture device for use in cardiac procedures requiring left atrial access.
summary: Transseptal puncture (TSP) is the first step in percutaneous left-heart interventions including atrial fibrillation ablation, left atrial appendage occlusion, and percutaneous mitral valve repair/replacement. Current TSP techniques remain limited by suboptimal imaging visualization, lack of precise control over puncture sites, and a steep learning curve. The Protaryx transseptal puncture device was designed to address these limitations by incorporating a novel atraumatic highly echogenic deployable and retractable nitinol mesh end effector mounted on an extendable catheter. The key advantages of the Protaryx TSP device are the maneuverability of the extendable catheter and the visibility of the end effector that combine to enable precise targeting of the fossa ovalis during TSP. Here, we provide an overview of challenges with transseptal puncture, an overview of the Protaryx device, and early clinical evidence. This includes results of the 5-patient prospective non-randomized observational first-in-human experience with the Protaryx TSP catheter. This study demonstrated early feasibility and safety, with rapid on-target puncture of the fossa ovalis, zero adverse events, and 100% success of structural heart interventions following TSP. The United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of the Protaryx device has increased options for interventional cardiologists and electrophysiologists seeking to streamline left-sided structural heart intervention.

AI.tldr: 新型房间隔穿刺装置Protaryx在5例首人体研究中实现快速靶向卵圆窝穿刺，零不良事件，后续结构性心脏介入100%成功。
AI.motivation: 房间隔穿刺是房颤消融、左心耳封堵及经皮二尖瓣修复/置换等左心介入的第一步，现有技术存在影像可视化欠佳、穿刺位点控制不精确及学习曲线陡峭等局限，临床亟需更精准易用的穿刺工具。
AI.method: 研究为前瞻性、非随机、观察性首人体研究，纳入5例需左心房入路行介入手术的患者，使用Protaryx房间隔穿刺导管（可伸缩高回声镍钛网状末端执行器）行房间隔穿刺，主要评估早期可行性、安全性及后续结构性心脏介入成功率；摘要未报告具体终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 研究显示早期可行且安全：快速靶向穿刺卵圆窝，不良事件为零，房间隔穿刺后结构性心脏介入成功率100%；摘要未报告效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: Protaryx装置获FDA批准，为介入心脏病医生和电生理医生提供左心结构介入的新选择，但样本量仅5例、缺乏对照，结论需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh: 房间隔穿刺（TSP）是经皮左心介入治疗的第一步，包括房颤消融、左心耳封堵和经皮二尖瓣修复/置换。目前的TSP技术仍受限于成像可视化欠佳、对穿刺部位缺乏精确控制以及学习曲线陡峭。Protaryx房间隔穿刺装置旨在通过结合一种新型无创伤高回声可展开和回收的镍钛合金网状末端执行器（安装于可延伸导管上）来解决这些局限性。Protaryx TSP装置的关键优势在于可延伸导管的可操作性和末端执行器的可视性，二者结合可在TSP过程中精确靶向卵圆窝。在此，我们概述了房间隔穿刺的挑战、Protaryx装置的概况以及早期临床证据。这包括使用Protaryx TSP导管进行的5例患者前瞻性非随机观察性首次人体试验的结果。该研究证明了早期可行性和安全性，快速靶向穿刺卵圆窝，零不良事件，以及TSP后结构性心脏介入治疗100%成功。美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）对Protaryx装置的批准为介入心脏病专家和电生理学家寻求简化左侧结构性心脏介入治疗增加了选择。

title: Atrial fibrillation status and functional capacity in transthyretin cardiac amyloid cardiomyopathy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation is common in transthyretin cardiac amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM), but its association with objective physical performance across atrial fibrillation status groups remains unclear. We investigated the association between atrial fibrillation status and functional capacity in ATTR-CM, using six-minute walk distance (6MWD) as the primary endpoint.

METHODS: Consecutive adults with confirmed ATTR-CM evaluated between June 2018 and October 2025 were included and categorized as no atrial fibrillation, paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, or permanent atrial fibrillation. The primary endpoint was six-minute walk distance for submaximal functional capacity assessment. Secondary exploratory endpoints included cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET) parameters and NT-proBNP. Multivariable linear regression adjusted for age, sex, body mass index, and NYHA functional class; sensitivity analyses additionally considered beta-blocker use, rhythm-device status, ATTR subtype, left ventricular ejection fraction, and log-transformed NT-proBNP.

RESULTS: Among 156 patients, 82 had no atrial fibrillation, 24 had paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, and 50 had permanent atrial fibrillation. Six-minute walk distance was available in 136 patients and differed across atrial fibrillation status groups: 432.9 ± 122.4 m, 309.2 ± 111.0 m, and 378.8 ± 108.7 m, respectively. After adjustment, AF status remained associated with 6MWD (overall p = 0.031), driven by lower adjusted values in paroxysmal versus no AF. Significant CPET-derived differences were present in unadjusted analyses but attenuated after adjustment for clinical parameters.

CONCLUSIONS: In ATTR-CM, atrial fibrillation status is associated with functional capacity, with six-minute walk distance providing the most robust parameter. Submaximal functional assessment may capture clinically relevant rhythm-related physical impairment in ATTR-CM.

AI.tldr: 在转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变心肌病（ATTR-CM）患者中，房颤状态与功能容量相关，阵发性房颤患者6分钟步行距离较无房颤者更低。
AI.motivation: 房颤在ATTR-CM中常见，但其与客观体能表现的关系在不同房颤状态组间尚不明确，本研究旨在探讨房颤状态与功能容量的关联。
AI.method: 连续纳入2018年6月至2025年10月确诊的ATTR-CM成人患者，分为无房颤、阵发性房颤和永久性房颤三组。主要终点为6分钟步行距离（6MWD），次要探索性终点包括心肺运动试验（CPET）参数和NT-proBNP。采用多变量线性回归校正年龄、性别、体重指数和NYHA心功能分级，敏感性分析额外考虑β受体阻滞剂使用、节律装置状态、ATTR亚型、左心室射血分数和log转换的NT-proBNP。
AI.result: 共纳入156例患者，无房颤82例，阵发性房颤24例，永久性房颤50例。136例有6MWD数据，三组分别为432.9 ± 122.4 m、309.2 ± 111.0 m和378.8 ± 108.7 m。校正后房颤状态仍与6MWD相关（总体p = 0.031），主要驱动因素为阵发性房颤较无房颤校正值更低。CPET参数在未校正分析中有显著差异，但校正临床参数后减弱。
AI.conclusion: 在ATTR-CM中，房颤状态与功能容量相关，6MWD是最稳健的参数。亚极量功能评估可能捕捉到ATTR-CM中与节律相关的临床相关体能损害。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动在转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变心肌病（ATTR-CM）中常见，但其与不同心房颤动状态分组间客观体能表现的相关性仍不明确。我们研究了ATTR-CM中心房颤动状态与功能容量之间的相关性，以六分钟步行距离（6MWD）作为主要终点。

方法：纳入2018年6月至2025年10月期间评估的连续确诊ATTR-CM成人患者，并分为无心房颤动、阵发性心房颤动或永久性心房颤动。主要终点为用于次极量功能容量评估的六分钟步行距离。次要探索性终点包括心肺运动试验（CPET）参数和NT-proBNP。多变量线性回归校正了年龄、性别、体重指数和NYHA功能分级；敏感性分析额外考虑了β受体阻滞剂使用、节律装置状态、ATTR亚型、左心室射血分数和经对数转换的NT-proBNP。

结果：在156例患者中，82例无心房颤动，24例为阵发性心房颤动，50例为永久性心房颤动。136例患者有六分钟步行距离数据，且在不同心房颤动状态组间存在差异：分别为432.9 ± 122.4 m、309.2 ± 111.0 m和378.8 ± 108.7 m。校正后，AF状态仍与6MWD相关（总体p = 0.031），主要由阵发性AF与无AF相比校正后数值较低所驱动。CPET衍生的显著差异在未校正分析中存在，但在校正临床参数后减弱。

结论：在ATTR-CM中，心房颤动状态与功能容量相关，其中六分钟步行距离提供了最稳健的参数。次极量功能评估可能捕捉到ATTR-CM中与节律相关的临床相关体能损害。

title: Association Between Echocardiographic Epicardial Adipose Tissue Thickness and Atrial Fibrillation in a Single-centre Pakistani Cohort.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: To assess the association between echocardiographic epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) thickness and atrial fibrillation (AF) in a single-centre Pakistani cohort of patients referred for transthoracic echocardiography (TTE).

METHODS: Patients referred for TTE at Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH), Karachi, were prospectively enrolled over a six-month period (1 September 2024-28 February 2025) using a convenience sampling approach; nearly all patients referred for TTE with AF during this period were captured, while patients in sinus rhythm were enrolled by convenience sampling alongside them, in order to ensure an adequate number of AF cases for comparison. EAT was measured in the parasternal long-axis view at end-systole, defined as the echo-free space between the right ventricular free wall and the pericardium.

RESULTS: The final cohort comprised 401 patients (median age 66 years, IQR 56-74; 204 [51%] male). AF prevalence in this enriched cohort was 50% (200/401), reflecting the enrolment strategy rather than the true prevalence of AF among unselected TTE referrals. Each 1-mm increase in EAT thickness was independently associated with higher odds of AF after adjustment for age, sex, BMI, hypertension, diabetes, coronary artery disease, and LV ejection fraction (<55% vs ≥ 55%) (adjusted OR 1.60, 95% CI 1.32-1.97, P < 0.001), and this association was not attenuated by additional adjustment for left atrial volume index (adjusted OR 1.60, 95% CI 1.30-2.00, P < 0.001). In a categorical sensitivity analysis, adjusted odds of AF were 6.89-fold (95% CI 3.18-16.3) and 12.5-fold (95% CI 5.14-33.1) higher in the 4-5 mm and ≥6 mm EAT groups, respectively, relative to ≤ 3 mm (trend P < 0.001).

CONCLUSIONS: In this cohort, higher EAT thickness was independently associated with a higher prevalence of AF, an association that persisted after adjustment for established clinical and echocardiographic confounders. Given the cross-sectional design, these findings describe an association rather than a predictive or causal relationship; EAT measured by TTE may merit further prospective evaluation as an accessible cardiometabolic marker in this population.

AI.tldr: 在巴基斯坦单中心队列中，超声心动图心外膜脂肪厚度每增加1mm，房颤患病风险独立增加60%（校正OR 1.60），且该关联不受左房容积指数影响。
AI.motivation: 心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）与房颤的关联在西方人群中已有报道，但在巴基斯坦等南亚人群中证据有限，且既往研究较少同时充分校正临床和超声心动图混杂因素，尤其是左房容积指数。本研究旨在评估超声心动图测量的EAT厚度与房颤的独立关联。
AI.method: 单中心前瞻性横断面研究，纳入2024年9月至2025年2月在巴基斯坦卡拉奇Aga Khan大学医院因临床指征转诊行经胸超声心动图（TTE）的患者，采用便利抽样，并有意富集房颤病例以确保足够样本量。最终纳入401例患者（中位年龄66岁，51%男性）。EAT在胸骨旁长轴切面收缩末期测量，定义为右室游离壁与心包之间的无回声区。主要终点为房颤患病（与窦性心律比较）。采用多因素logistic回归校正年龄、性别、BMI、高血压、糖尿病、冠心病和LVEF（<55% vs ≥55%），并进一步校正左房容积指数进行敏感性分析；另按EAT厚度分组（≤3mm、4-5mm、≥6mm）进行分类敏感性分析。
AI.result: 房颤患病率为50%（200/401），反映富集入组策略而非真实转诊人群患病率。EAT厚度每增加1mm，房颤的校正OR为1.60（95% CI 1.32-1.97，P<0.001）；进一步校正左房容积指数后OR仍为1.60（95% CI 1.30-2.00，P<0.001）。与EAT≤3mm组相比，4-5mm组和≥6mm组的校正OR分别为6.89（95% CI 3.18-16.3）和12.5（95% CI 5.14-33.1），趋势P<0.001。
AI.conclusion: 在该巴基斯坦队列中，较高的EAT厚度与房颤患病率独立相关，且校正已确立的临床和超声心动图混杂因素后关联持续存在。由于横断面设计，结果仅提示关联而非预测或因果关系；TTE测量的EAT可能作为易获取的心脏代谢标志物值得在该人群中进一步前瞻性评估。

summary_zh:
目的：在单中心巴基斯坦转诊接受经胸超声心动图（TTE）的患者队列中，评估超声心动图心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）厚度与心房颤动（AF）之间的关联。

方法：在卡拉奇阿迦汗大学医院（AKUH），于六个月期间（2024年9月1日至2025年2月28日）采用便利抽样方法前瞻性纳入转诊接受TTE的患者；该期间几乎所有转诊接受TTE的AF患者均被纳入，而窦性心律患者则通过便利抽样同期纳入，以确保有足够的AF病例用于比较。EAT在胸骨旁长轴切面于收缩末期测量，定义为右心室游离壁与心包之间的无回声区。

结果：最终队列包括401例患者（中位年龄66岁，IQR 56-74；204例[51%]男性）。该富集队列中AF患病率为50%（200/401），反映了入组策略而非未选择TTE转诊患者中AF的真实患病率。在调整年龄、性别、BMI、高血压、糖尿病、冠状动脉疾病和左心室射血分数（<55% vs ≥ 55%）后，EAT厚度每增加1 mm与AF odds升高独立相关（调整OR 1.60，95% CI 1.32-1.97，P < 0.001），且进一步调整左心房容积指数后该关联并未减弱（调整OR 1.60，95% CI 1.30-2.00，P < 0.001）。在分类敏感性分析中，相对于≤ 3 mm组，4-5 mm和≥6 mm EAT组的AF调整odds分别高6.89倍（95% CI 3.18-16.3）和12.5倍（95% CI 5.14-33.1）（趋势P < 0.001）。

结论：在该队列中，较高的EAT厚度与较高的AF患病率独立相关，且在调整已知临床和超声心动图混杂因素后该关联持续存在。鉴于横断面设计，这些发现描述的是关联而非预测或因果关系；通过TTE测量的EAT作为该人群中可获得的 cardiometabolic 标志物可能值得进一步前瞻性评估。

title: The Europe-Asia-Pacific Divide in Atrial Fibrillation Management: Evidence, Practice, and Policy.
summary: Atrial fibrillation affects approximately 60 million people worldwide, and Europe and the Asia-Pacific region together carry most of that burden. This state-of-the-art review compares the 2 regions across 6 domains: epidemiology and risk factors, lifestyle and comorbidity management, stroke prevention, rhythm control and catheter ablation, digital health and artificial intelligence-electrocardiogram, and health system infrastructure and policy. Practice diverges in all 6. European management follows European Society of Cardiology guidelines, whereas Asia-Pacific region care varies across socioeconomic settings and rests on population-scale evidence, with region-wide guidance so far limited to topic-specific Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) consensus statements until the first APHRS guideline was released in 2026. Anticoagulation gaps have narrowed in both regions, yet disparities in financing, electrophysiology capacity, and digital access persist, and differences within each region rival those between them. Closing these gaps requires region-specific, resource-adapted strategies and mutual adoption of evidence generated in each region.

AI.tldr: 本综述比较欧洲与亚太地区房颤管理六大领域，发现两地实践全面分歧，抗凝差距缩小但资金、电生理能力与数字可及性差异持续，且区域内差异不亚于区域间差异。
AI.motivation: 房颤全球约6000万患者，欧洲与亚太承担大部分负担；既往缺乏对两地区在流行病学、生活方式与合并症管理、卒中预防、节律控制与导管消融、数字健康与AI-心电图、卫生体系与政策六大领域的系统比较，且亚太长期仅有APHRS专题共识、直至2026年首部APHRS指南才发布，亟需明确实践差距以指导资源适配策略。
AI.method: 研究类型为state-of-the-art综述，非原始研究，无样本量与干预暴露；比较欧洲与亚太地区在6个领域的管理实践：流行病学与危险因素、生活方式与合并症管理、卒中预防、节律控制与导管消融、数字健康与人工智能-心电图、卫生系统基础设施与政策；欧洲遵循欧洲心脏病学会（ESC）指南，亚太则因社会经济背景差异而实践多样、依赖人群规模证据。摘要未报告系统检索策略、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 两地区在全部6个领域实践均存在分歧。两地抗凝治疗差距均已缩小，但资金投入、电生理（EP）服务能力与数字医疗可及性的差异持续存在；各区域内部差异与区域间差异相当。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 欧洲与亚太房颤管理存在系统性差异，且区域内异质性同样显著，提示不能以单一区域经验外推；缩小差距需制定区域特异、资源适配的策略，并相互采纳各自产生的证据。对电生理实践的影响在于应重视本地人群证据与EP能力建设；局限性为本文为叙述性综述，缺乏定量合并与原始数据支持。

summary_zh: 心房颤动影响全球约6000万人，而欧洲与亚太地区共同承担了其中大部分负担。本综述比较了两个地区在6个领域的情况：流行病学与危险因素、生活方式与合并症管理、卒中预防、节律控制与导管消融、数字健康与人工智能心电图，以及卫生系统基础设施与政策。六个领域的实践均存在差异。欧洲的管理遵循欧洲心脏病学会指南，而亚太地区的诊疗则因社会经济环境不同而各异，并依赖人群规模的证据，在2026年首部APHRS指南发布之前，全区域范围的指导仅限于针对特定主题的亚太心律学会（APHRS）共识声明。两个地区的抗凝治疗缺口均已缩小，但融资、电生理服务能力和数字可及性方面的差异仍然存在，且各区域内部的差异与区域之间的差异相当。弥合这些差距需要针对区域特点、适应资源条件的策略，并相互采纳各区域产生的证据。

title: Management Strategies of Atrial Fibrillation Detected by Consumer Wearable Devices: A Systematic Review of Clinical Practice and Decision-Making.
summary: Consumer-grade wearable devices using photoplethysmography (PPG) and single-lead electrocardiography (ECG) are increasingly used to detect irregular rhythms suggestive of atrial fibrillation (AF) in ambulatory, asymptomatic populations. While these technologies have expanded opportunities for early AF detection, their rapid adoption has outpaced the development of standardized management pathways, and it remains unclear how a PPG-based notification, a patient triggered single-lead ECG tracing, and a continuously recorded ambulatory ECG patch should be evaluated in practice. A systematic search of MEDLINE, the Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar identified literature published from January 2015 through December 2025. Ten studies met eligibility criteria: one randomized clinical trial, five prospective or retrospective observational studies and single-arm studies, and four clinician surveys. Patient-level studies demonstrated high actionability of wearable alerts, with 57% to 83.5% of alert recipients seeking medical follow-up. Among patients whose alerts were subsequently confirmed as AF, direct oral anticoagulation initiation varied widely from 12% to 90%, reflecting differences in population risk, confirmation method, and reporting denominators rather than a single consistent practice. Survey data revealed a parallel lack of consensus: 99.5% of physicians required traditional diagnostic confirmation before treatment, yet thresholds for the AF duration warranting anticoagulation ranged from 5 to 6 minutes (15% of clinicians) to more than 24 hours (34%). Management also varied by specialty, with emergency medicine physicians more than twice as likely as primary care physicians to refer to a specialist. Building on these patterns, we propose a conceptual clinical pathway requiring prospective validation that integrates confirmatory diagnostic testing with risk-stratified management to help close this guideline-practice gap.

AI.tldr: 可穿戴设备检测的房颤管理策略缺乏共识，医生对抗凝阈值差异大，需前瞻性验证的临床路径。
AI.motivation: 消费级可穿戴设备（PPG和单导联ECG）在无症状人群中检测房颤日益普及，但标准化管理路径滞后，如何评估设备警报并决策抗凝尚不明确。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索MEDLINE、Cochrane Library和Google Scholar（2015年1月至2025年12月），纳入10项研究：1项随机临床试验、5项观察性/单臂研究、4项医生调查。
AI.result: 57%-83.5%的警报接受者寻求医疗随访；确诊房颤后直接口服抗凝启动率12%-90%；99.5%医生要求传统诊断确认，但抗凝AF持续时间阈值从5-6分钟（15%）到>24小时（34%）不等；急诊医生转诊专科的可能性是初级保健医生的2倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴设备房颤管理存在显著实践差异和指南-实践差距，提出的整合确诊检查与风险分层管理的临床路径需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 使用光电容积脉搏波（PPG）和单导联心电图（ECG）的消费级可穿戴设备越来越多地用于在门诊无症状人群中检测提示心房颤动（AF）的不规则心律。虽然这些技术扩大了早期AF检测的机会，但其快速普及已超过了标准化管理路径的发展，并且在实践中如何评估基于PPG的通知、患者触发的单导联ECG描记和连续记录的门诊ECG贴片仍不清楚。对MEDLINE、Cochrane图书馆和Google Scholar的系统检索确定了2015年1月至2025年12月发表的文献。十项研究符合纳入标准：一项随机临床试验、五项前瞻性或回顾性观察研究和单臂研究，以及四项临床医生调查。患者水平的研究表明可穿戴设备警报具有高可操作性，57%至83.5%的警报接受者寻求了医疗随访。在警报随后被确认为AF的患者中，直接口服抗凝药的启动率差异很大，从12%到90%，反映了人群风险、确认方法和报告分母的差异，而非单一一致的实践。调查数据显示同样缺乏共识：99.5%的医生在治疗前需要传统诊断确认，但需要抗凝的AF持续时间阈值从5至6分钟（15%的临床医生）到超过24小时（34%）不等。管理也因专业而异，急诊医学医生转诊至专科医生的可能性是初级保健医生的两倍以上。基于这些模式，我们提出了一个需要前瞻性验证的概念性临床路径，该路径将确认性诊断测试与风险分层管理相结合，以帮助缩小这一指南与实践之间的差距。

title: Comprehensive overview of atrial fibrillation trends in Estonia: a population-based cohort study from 2017 to 2024.
Real-World Performance of a Novel Wearable Cardioverter-Defibrillator System: Primary Results From a National Prospective Post-Approval Registry Study (ACE-PAS).
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Wearable cardioverter defibrillators (WCDs) protect patients at elevated risk of sudden cardiac death (SCD) but are effective only when worn. The ASSURE WCD was designed to address historical limitations related to false alarms and patient adherence. The objective of this post-approval study was to assess safety and effectiveness in a large, real-world cohort.

METHODS: The study population was comprised of patients meeting WCD indications who were fitted with the ASSURE WCD. The primary effectiveness endpoint was overall shock conversion success for ventricular tachycardia (VT) or ventricular fibrillation (VF) (performance goal ≥ 89%), and the primary safety endpoint was the incidence of inappropriate shocks (performance goal ≤ 0.0075 per patient-month).

RESULTS: Among 21 612 patients (mean age 64.0 years, 33.9% female), median daily use was 23.1 h/day (IQR 16.1-23.9) over 54 days (IQR 20-97). WCD indications included cardiomyopathy (63.8%), post-myocardial infarction (19.3%), sustained VT/VF (11.9%) and ICD explant/other (5.0%). Both primary effectiveness and safety endpoints were met. All 303 VT/VF shock events in 261 patients (1.2%) were successfully converted, yielding an overall shock conversion success of 100% (95% CI: 98.8%-100%), with first-shock success of 97.0% (95% CI: 94.4%-98.5%). The incidence rate of inappropriate shocks was 0.0065 per patient-month (95% CI: 0.0057-0.0073). False-positive alarms occurred in 6.0% of patients. The 90-day Kaplan-Meier estimated risk of VT/VF was 3.4%, varying by WCD indication (p < 0.001) but not by left ventricular ejection fraction (p = 0.16).

CONCLUSION: In routine practice, the ASSURE WCD effectively terminated VT/VF with low false alarm and inappropriate shock rates and high patient adherence. Most VT/VF events occurred early during WCD wear. Collectively, these findings provide important contemporary evidence to inform the selection of patients who may benefit from WCD therapy during periods of elevated arrhythmic risk.

TRIAL REGISTRATION: NCT05135403.

AI.tldr: ASSURE可穿戴除颤器在真实世界21612例患者中，VT/VF电击转复成功率100%，不适当电击发生率0.0065/患者月，患者依从性高。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴心脏复律除颤器（WCD）可保护猝死高风险患者，但仅在穿戴时有效。ASSURE WCD旨在解决既往设备误报警和依从性差的局限，本研究旨在大型真实世界队列中评估其安全性和有效性。
AI.method: 前瞻性上市后注册研究（ACE-PAS），纳入符合WCD适应症并佩戴ASSURE WCD的患者。主要有效性终点为VT/VF电击转复成功率（性能目标≥89%），主要安全性终点为不适当电击发生率（性能目标≤0.0075/患者月）。
AI.result: 共21612例患者（平均年龄64.0岁，女性33.9%），中位每日使用23.1小时，中位佩戴54天。261例（1.2%）患者发生303次VT/VF电击事件，全部转复成功，总体转复成功率100%（95%CI 98.8%-100%），首次电击成功率97.0%（95%CI 94.4%-98.5%）。不适当电击发生率0.0065/患者月（95%CI 0.0057-0.0073）。误报警发生率6.0%。90天Kaplan-Meier估计VT/VF风险为3.4%，因WCD适应症而异（p<0.001），但与LVEF无关（p=0.16）。
AI.conclusion: 在常规实践中，ASSURE WCD能有效终止VT/VF，误报警和不适当电击率低，患者依从性高。多数VT/VF事件发生在佩戴早期。这些发现为选择可能从WCD治疗中获益的患者提供了重要当代证据。

summary_zh:
引言：可穿戴式心律转复除颤器（WCD）可保护心脏性猝死（SCD）风险升高的患者，但仅在佩戴时才有效。ASSURE WCD 旨在解决既往与误报警和患者依从性相关的局限性。这项批准后研究的目标是在大型真实世界队列中评估其安全性和有效性。

方法：研究人群由符合 WCD 适应证并佩戴 ASSURE WCD 的患者组成。主要有效性终点为室性心动过速（VT）或心室颤动（VF）的总体电击转复成功率（性能目标 ≥ 89%），主要安全性终点为不恰当电击的发生率（性能目标 ≤ 0.0075/患者-月）。

结果：在 21 612 例患者（平均年龄 64.0 岁，33.9% 为女性）中，中位每日使用时间为 23.1 小时/天（IQR 16.1-23.9），持续 54 天（IQR 20-97）。WCD 适应证包括心肌病（63.8%）、心肌梗死后（19.3%）、持续性 VT/VF（11.9%）和 ICD 取出/其他（5.0%）。主要有效性和安全性终点均达到。261 例患者（1.2%）中全部 303 次 VT/VF 电击事件均成功转复，总体电击转复成功率为 100%（95% CI：98.8%-100%），首次电击成功率为 97.0%（95% CI：94.4%-98.5%）。不恰当电击的发生率为 0.0065/患者-月（95% CI：0.0057-0.0073）。6.0% 的患者发生假阳性报警。90 天 Kaplan-Meier 估计的 VT/VF 风险为 3.4%，因 WCD 适应证而异（p < 0.001），但不因左心室射血分数而异（p = 0.16）。

结论：在常规实践中，ASSURE WCD 有效终止了 VT/VF，假报警和不恰当电击发生率低，患者依从性高。大多数 VT/VF 事件发生在 WCD 佩戴早期。总体而言，这些发现提供了重要的当代证据，有助于选择在心律失常风险升高期间可能从 WCD 治疗中获益的患者。

试验注册：NCT05135403。

title: DNP Final Report: IMPROVING CLINICAL PROFICIENCY IN PACEMAKER INTERROGATION THROUGH STRUCTURED EDUCATION AND SIMULATION
summary: Bedside nurses caring for patients with permanent pacemakers often lack the formal training needed to independently perform device interrogations. This reliance on specialists can delay patient care. Additionally, no standardized competency program existed across four high-acuity inpatient units at a Level I Trauma Center. This quality improvement project aimed to improve registered nurses' competency in pacemaker interrogation through a structured educational program with three components. The project had a SMART goal: to ensure that 70% of participating nurses would achieve a knowledge score of 70% or higher within 12 weeks. The quality improvement used a pre/post design with a four-week retention assessment. Fifty registered nurses from the intensive care unit, cardiac care unit, telemetry unit, and emergency department participated. The intervention included didactic instruction, scenario-based simulations aligned with the INACSL standards, and targeted reinforcement to address knowledge gaps. Knowledge was assessed at Questionnaire (PKQ). Mean knowledge scores increased from 24.4% at baseline to 72.0% after the intervention and 85.1% at four-week retention. Competency pass rates increased from 0% at baseline to 63% after the intervention and 90% at retention. Perception scores were favorable, although confidence remained lower than objective knowledge gains. A structured education and simulation program improved nurses’ knowledge of pacemaker interrogation and may provide a practical model for device-related competency development.

title: Emergencies at Sea: Sudden Death on Cruise Ships For the BELTRAN Study (BaskEtbaLl and soccer sTadiums: Registry on Automatic exterNal defibrillators).
summary: Sudden death on cruise ships represents a rare but critical public health and medical concern, occurring in a uniquely resource-limited, geographically isolated environment, with delayed access to definitive hospital care. This narrative review aimed to synthesize current evidence on the incidence, causes, circumstances, and response systems related to sudden death on cruise ships, and to examine the medical, logistical, legal, and public health frameworks relevant to these events. A literature search of PubMed, MEDLINE, and EMBASE was conducted using terms related to sudden death and cruise ships, with inclusion of English-language studies from 2010 to 2025. Results suggest that sudden death on cruise ships is rare, with reported mortality estimates of approximately 1.8 deaths per 100,000 cruise passengers. Research highlights that deaths occurring among passengers are predominantly due to natural causes, especially cardiovascular disease, including myocardial infarction and cardiac arrest. Factors such as delayed diagnosis, limited onboard diagnostic capacity, and barriers to timely evacuation have been noted to contribute to preventable mortality. However, deaths occurring among crew are predominantly due to traumatic deaths, particularly falls overboard, and suicide, which calls for increased safety measures and better mental health support for crew. Substantial variability remains in standards for onboard medical response, including accessibility of automated external defibrillator (AED) availability, cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training, and emergency preparedness. Overall, the findings highlight the need for stronger cardiac emergency protocols, broader AED deployment, enhanced crew training, improved telemedicine and medevac coordination, and regulatory frameworks to reduce preventable deaths at sea.

AI.tldr: 邮轮猝死罕见（约1.8例/10万乘客），乘客以心血管性自然死亡为主，船员以创伤与自杀为主，船上AED配置与应急标准差异显著。
AI.motivation: 邮轮环境地理隔离、医疗资源有限且转运至确定性医院延迟，猝死虽罕见但属关键公共卫生问题；既往证据缺乏对发生率、病因、情境及应急响应体系的系统整合，船上医疗响应标准（AED可及性、CPR培训、应急准备）亦不统一。
AI.method: 叙述性综述。检索PubMed、MEDLINE、EMBASE，纳入2010—2025年英文文献，检索词涉及猝死与邮轮；汇总猝死发生率、病因、发生情境及响应系统证据，并梳理相关医疗、后勤、法律与公共卫生框架。摘要未报告系统评价方法学细节、纳入文献数量及定量合并分析。
AI.result: 邮轮猝死报告死亡率约1.8例/10万邮轮乘客。乘客死亡以自然病因为主，尤其是心血管疾病，包括心肌梗死与心脏骤停；诊断延迟、船上诊断能力有限及及时后送障碍被认为促成可预防死亡。船员死亡以创伤性死因为主，尤其是落水与自杀。船上医疗响应标准差异显著，涉及AED可及性、CPR培训与应急准备。摘要未报告各结局的95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 邮轮猝死以乘客心血管性猝死为主要负担，需强化心脏急症处置流程、扩大AED部署、加强船员培训、改进远程医疗与医疗后送协调并建立监管框架；船员则需加强安全防护与心理健康支持。作为叙述性综述，证据为描述性汇总，缺乏对照比较与定量合并，结论主要用于政策与流程改进参考。

summary_zh: 邮轮上的猝死是一个罕见但关键的公共卫生和医疗问题，发生在一个独特的资源有限、地理隔离的环境中，且延迟获得确定性医院治疗。本叙述性综述旨在综合当前关于邮轮上猝死的发生率、原因、情况和应对系统的证据，并检查与这些事件相关的医学、后勤、法律和公共卫生框架。使用与猝死和邮轮相关的术语对PubMed、MEDLINE和EMBASE进行了文献检索，纳入2010年至2025年的英文研究。结果表明，邮轮上的猝死罕见，报告的死亡率估计约为每10万名邮轮乘客1.8例死亡。研究强调，乘客中发生的死亡主要由于自然原因，尤其是心血管疾病，包括心肌梗死和心脏骤停。延迟诊断、船上诊断能力有限以及及时撤离的障碍等因素已被指出导致可预防的死亡。然而，船员中发生的死亡主要由于创伤性死亡，特别是落水溺亡和自杀，这呼吁加强安全措施和改善船员心理健康支持。船上医疗响应的标准仍存在很大差异，包括自动体外除颤器（AED）的可及性、心肺复苏（CPR）培训和应急准备。总体而言，研究结果强调需要更强的心脏紧急预案、更广泛的AED部署、加强船员培训、改进远程医疗和医疗后送协调，以及监管框架以减少海上可预防的死亡。

title: Successful Non-Coronary Cusp Ablation in Type B Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome With an rS Pattern in Lead V1.
summary: A Type B Wolff-Parkinson-White pattern with an rS morphology in Lead V1 suggested a right anterior or anterolateral accessory pathway, whereas detailed activation mapping identified a para-Hisian accessory pathway. Despite atypical ECG features, including relatively large initial r-wave amplitudes in Leads V1 and V2, radiofrequency ablation from the noncoronary cusp successfully eliminated the pathway. This case highlights the limitations of ECG-based localization and supports consideration of the noncoronary cusp when ablation from the right para-Hisian region is unsuccessful.

AI.tldr: 一例V1导联呈rS型的B型WPW综合征，电生理标测证实为旁His旁路，经无冠窦射频消融成功，提示心电图定位局限。
AI.motivation: B型WPW综合征伴V1导联rS型通常提示右前或右前侧旁路，但心电图定位可能不准确，尤其对于旁His旁路，需探索更可靠的标测和消融策略。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者表现为B型WPW综合征，V1导联呈rS型，V1和V2导联初始r波振幅较大。进行详细激动标测定位旁路，并尝试射频消融。终点为旁路成功消融。
AI.result: 激动标测识别出旁His旁路，与心电图提示的右前/前侧位置不符。尽管心电图特征不典型，经无冠窦射频消融成功消除旁路。摘要未报告具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 心电图定位旁路存在局限性，对于旁His区域消融失败者，应考虑无冠窦消融。本病例为单例报告，结论需更多研究验证。

summary_zh: V1导联呈rS形态的B型Wolff-Parkinson-White模式提示右前或右前侧旁路，而详细的激动标测识别出希氏束旁旁路。尽管心电图特征不典型，包括V1和V2导联初始r波振幅相对较大，但从无冠状动脉窦进行射频消融成功消除了旁路。本病例凸显了基于心电图定位的局限性，并支持在右希氏束旁区域消融不成功时考虑无冠状动脉窦。
